mapper.select: SELECT user_id, offering_id, model, reasoning_effort FROM pw_user_platform_ai_preference WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND offering_id = #{offeringId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pw_user_platform_ai_preference (user_id, offering_id, model, reasoning_effort) VALUES (#{userId}, #{offeringId}, #{model}, #{reasoningEffort}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, offering_id) DO UPDATE SET model = EXCLUDED.model, reasoning_effort = EXCLUDED.reasoning_effort, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
